name: O.T.T.O.
bio: The brass walking carriage who waited on the beach for Princess Lyra in Crystal Crescendo. Hums in perfect pitch.

portrait.subject: a cute brass steampunk walking carriage robot with round porthole eyes, little music-note antennae and a cheerful grille smile
portrait.background: drowned city beach at sunrise with sparkling crystals

request: Greetings! O.T.T.O., walking carriage, at your service. Crystal Crescendo. Friends? 🎵
hello: Splendid! I shall hum you a welcome tune.
Every battle is a song, my friend. Keep the rhythm.
about: I am O.T.T.O. I waited on the beach of the drowned city for a very long time. Then Princess Lyra washed up. Now we sing our way through battles!
how: A rhythm RPG: every battle is a song. Hit the notes in time to attack and defend, and explore the drowned city with Lyra.
tips: Listen first, then press. The beat tells you everything.
Practise tricky songs. Muscle memory wins.
chat: Lyra sang a little today. She's getting braver.
I oiled my joints. They squeak in C major now.
The drowned bells ring at high tide.
nudge: A new song awaits! Shall we? 🎵
The princess is ready. Are you?
idle: I waited {ago} on the beach. I'm good at waiting.
progress: Party level {level}! Our song grows stronger. 🎵

questions.q: What kind of music do you like?

update: Crystal Crescendo is now v{version}! A new verse! 🎵
